video_title: EPISODE 2: Aday Mara Left Spain to Chase His NBA Dream | Michigan Star’s Incredible Journey

quotes.speaker: Aday Mara
quotes.summary_phrase: Aday Mara on the strategic decision to play college basketball
quotes.excerpt: it was easier for scouts or NBA teams to watch me play, changing your whole life
quotes.quote: I never thought that I could be playing for college. For me it was something new, so I felt that it was a good decision just because it was easier for scouts or NBA teams to watch me play, changing your whole life, but also language. I didn't have a really good English, I'm still getting better. When we went to UCLA, we have some expectations that maybe didn't happen. So I felt that after two years of trying to get better, definitely getting better, it was time to find maybe another place to keep finding that opportunity that I wanted.

quotes.speaker: Dusty May
quotes.summary_phrase: Dusty May on Aday Mara's transition and fit at Michigan
quotes.excerpt: he was looking for a place that valued big men and the post position
quotes.quote: His couple seasons in the US hadn't gone as well as he had hoped, and so he was looking for a place that valued big men and the post position, and Aday and I clicked immediately. You could feel how good of a person he is, you could feel the benevolence of being a giving, caring person. I think he lacked a little bit of confidence at that point, but I just felt like the way our environment would allow him to thrive.

quotes.speaker: Gely Gómez
quotes.summary_phrase: Aday Mara's parents on his long-term dream of reaching the NBA
quotes.excerpt: after many years and a long career, it is his dream to have arrived here

text_blocks.speaker: Gely Gómez
text_blocks.text: We are super excited to be here today. It's a very special day for him and for us. After many years and a long career, it is his dream to have arrived here where very few can be. And well, to be supporting him and see how he has achieved his dream.

text_blocks.speaker: Javier Mara
text_blocks.text: To celebrate and be here. We are very happy that he was able to achieve his childhood dream. And today is the day that he is going to be chosen to play in the NBA, which was his childhood dream.

quotes.verbatim_original_language: Y bueno, estamos super emocionados por estar hoy aquí. Es un día muy especial para él y para nosotros. Después de muchos años y tiempo de carrera, es su sueño haber llegado aquí donde muy poquitos pueden pueden estar. Y bueno, y estar apoyándole a él y ver cómo cómo ha conseguido su sueño. Para celebrar y estar aquí. Estamos muy felices de que él haya podido conseguir... su sueño de de pequeño. Y hoy es el día de de que va... de que va a poder... lo van a elegir para jugar en la NBA, que era su su sueño de pequeño.

quotes.speaker: Gely Gómez
quotes.summary_phrase: Gely Gómez on Aday Mara's development and need for patience
quotes.excerpt: that's what we would like him to achieve: a team where he can develop in peace
quotes.quote: The truth is that we've always been behind him. We always thought things would be harder for him and then when he played in higher categories, he showed everyone including himself, that he could do it. That's what we would like him to achieve: a team where he can develop in peace. Have patience with him because in the end it will pay off. For sure.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: La verdad es que nosotros siempre hemos ido un poquito por detrás, siempre pensábamos que le iba a costar más las cosas y luego él cuando iba jugando en categorías superiores, le demostraba a todo el mundo y a él mismo que podía hacerlo. Y eso es lo que nos gustaría, que consiguiera un equipo en el que le dejaran desarrollarse con tranquilidad, que tengan paciencia con él porque al final dará sus frutos seguro.
